correctness.rationale: For K_mu(x)=mu*x*(1-x)/(1+x), 0<mu<=3+2sqrt(2), verified K^2-x rational factorization with quadratic primitive-cycle factor Q, discriminant (mu^2-1)(mu^2-4mu-1), unique two-cycle for mu>2+sqrt(5), and multiplier 1-(mu^2-1)(mu^2-4mu-1)/(2mu^2). The strictly decreasing multiplier crosses -1 uniquely at mu_f=1+sqrt(2)+sqrt(4+2sqrt(2)). The exact negative Schwarzian of K gives positive cubic normal coefficient of K^2 and transverse flip, yielding exactly one local attracting 4-cycle for mu>mu_f near threshold with two explicit distinct square-root amplitudes. Independently recalculated symbolic identities, quartic radical and numerical amplitude values.
